lines.en: Sixteen pieces. Four attributes. One rule.
lines.zh: 十六枚棋子，四种属性，一条规则。

lines.en: Quarto. Choose a piece and hand it to your opponent.
lines.zh: 四连棋。选一枚棋子，交给对手。

lines.en: They place it, then choose the next piece for you. Every gift shapes the board.
lines.zh: 对手放好棋子，再为你选下一枚。每一份礼物都在塑造棋盘。

lines.en: Four pieces in a line share one attribute — that is a quarto.
lines.zh: 一条线上四枚棋子共享一种属性，就是四连。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from a gentle companion to forced-piece search.
lines.zh: 四档电脑难度，从温和陪玩到强制棋子搜索。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins on the same Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一网络加入。

lines.en: Hints that explain why, undo, autosave, a family record. Offline, no account, no ads.
lines.zh: 会解释原因的提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。离线、无账号、无广告。
四连棋。十六枚棋子，一条规则。
